description: This file defines wrapper functions and types for enhancing Prometheus collectors and registerers with additional labels or prefixes, facilitating more flexible metric registration and collection.

classes.name: wrappingRegisterer
classes.description: A struct that wraps a Registerer to add prefix and labels to registered collectors.

classes.name: wrappingCollector
classes.description: A struct that wraps a Collector to add prefix and labels to metrics and descriptions.

classes.name: wrappingMetric
classes.description: A struct that wraps a Metric to modify its description and labels.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a collector with the wrapped Registerer, applying prefix and labels.

methods.name: MustRegister
methods.description: Registers multiple collectors, panicking on error.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a collector from the wrapped Registerer.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects metrics from the wrapped collector, applying prefix and labels.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Describes metrics from the wrapped collector, applying prefix and labels.

methods.name: unwrapRecursively
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested wrappingCollector instances to get the original collector.

methods.name: Desc
methods.description: Returns the description of the wrapped metric, with prefix and labels applied.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the wrapped metric, adding labels and sorting label pairs.
